responsibility: This header defines GCC's hard-register set abstraction and the target-global register metadata built on top of it. It chooses the representation for HARD_REG_SET, provides bit operations, subset/intersection/emptiness helpers, array traits integration, and then declares target_hard_regs, which owns accessible/fixed/call-used/savable register sets, reg-class contents, allocation orders, and related tables. It is the foundational representation layer for hard-register liveness, allocation, and target register-class queries across the backend.
